# Security policy

Security reports for this repository should be shared privately with the
maintainers. Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

## Supported versions

The current `main` branch is supported during development. Release support will
be documented when the first release is published.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/docling-project/docling-context/security/advisories/new) when it is available.
